text.zh-CN:
玫瑰痤疮主要影响面中部，是会反复发作的炎症性皮肤病。

- 可有阵发潮红、持续颜色变化、细小可见血管，或像痘痘一样的丘疹和脓疱；皮肤可能发烫、刺痛。
- 有些人眼睛干涩、发红或有异物感，少数出现鼻部皮肤增厚；不同表现需要不同治疗。
text.en:
Rosacea is a recurring inflammatory condition that mainly affects the central face.

- Features include flushing, persistent color change, small visible vessels or pimple-like bumps and pustules, with warmth, burning or stinging.
- Some have dry, red or gritty eyes, and some develop thickened nasal skin; different features require different treatments.

text.zh-CN:
病因不是单一感染，遗传、炎症、皮肤屏障和环境因素可能共同作用。

- 日晒、温差、热饮、酒精、辛辣和压力可使部分人发作；诱因因人而异，不等于患病的责任在自己。
- 浅肤色更容易看见红斑，但深肤色同样会患病，可能因不明显而漏诊；玫瑰痤疮不传染，也不是不爱洗脸造成的。
text.en:
There is no single infectious cause; inherited factors, inflammation, the skin barrier and environmental exposures may interact.

- Sun, temperature changes, hot drinks, alcohol, spicy foods or stress may trigger flares in some people; triggers differ and are not a reason to blame yourself.
- Redness is easier to see in light skin, but darker skin is also affected and may be underdiagnosed. Rosacea is not contagious and is not caused by poor washing.

text.zh-CN:
眼部变化比单纯面部潮红更需要及时处理。

- 眼痛、怕光、视物模糊，或红眼伴持续异物感时，当天寻求眼科或急诊分流；角膜是眼球前方透明表面，发炎可能损害视力。
- 不要把皮肤用的抗生素霜放进眼里，眼部治疗需要专用制剂。
text.en:
Eye changes need more prompt attention than uncomplicated facial flushing.

- Get same-day eye assessment or urgent triage for eye pain, light sensitivity, blurred vision or red eyes with persistent grittiness. Inflammation of the clear front surface, the cornea, can threaten vision.
- Do not put skin antibiotic creams into the eyes; eye treatment needs formulations intended for that use.

text.zh-CN:
反复发作可以预约皮肤科确认表现和诱因。

- 持续面部颜色变化、反复刺痛或丘疹，尤其影响日常生活时预约就诊，并带上护肤品和药物清单。
- 鼻部逐渐增厚或出现坚硬小结节时复诊，越早处理越有机会控制进展。
- 已开始治疗但明显加重、无法耐受或出现眼症状，应提前联系医生，不必等原定复诊。
text.en:
Recurring symptoms can be assessed by a dermatologist to identify features and triggers.

- Arrange assessment for persistent facial color changes, recurrent stinging or bumps, especially when daily life is affected; bring a list of skin products and medicines.
- Return for increasing nasal thickening or firm bumps; earlier management offers a better chance of limiting progression.
- Contact the clinician earlier if treatment is followed by worsening, intolerable effects or eye symptoms.

text.zh-CN:
诊断主要依靠皮肤和眼部表现，没有一项抽血能单独确诊。

- 医生会询问潮红持续多久、什么会诱发、是否有眼症状及用过哪些外用药；就诊当天不发红也不排除反复性病症。
- 表现不典型时，检查或小块皮肤取样用于排除狼疮等相似问题，而不是每个人都需要全套检查。
text.en:
Diagnosis mainly depends on skin and eye findings; no single blood test establishes rosacea.

- Clinicians ask about timing, triggers, eye symptoms and topical products; a clear day at the appointment does not exclude a recurring condition.
- For atypical findings, tests or a small skin biopsy may exclude conditions such as lupus; a full battery of tests is not routine for everyone.

text.zh-CN:
脸红或长丘疹有多种原因，治疗前先分清。

- 痤疮、口周皮炎和脂溢性皮炎都可能像玫瑰痤疮；分布、鳞屑及完整皮肤表现帮助医生区分。
- 护肤品接触反应或药物引起的潮红也要考虑；反复自己加用外用激素可能使面部问题更复杂。
- 伴其他身体表现或不典型持续皮疹时，医生可能排除狼疮等全身疾病，不能单凭一张照片确定。
text.en:
Facial redness and bumps have several causes that need distinguishing before treatment.

- Acne, perioral dermatitis and seborrheic dermatitis can resemble rosacea; distribution, scale and the full skin pattern help clinicians distinguish them.
- Contact reactions to products and medicine-related flushing also matter; repeatedly adding topical steroids yourself may complicate facial symptoms.
- With other physical symptoms or an atypical persistent eruption, clinicians may exclude systemic conditions such as lupus; a photograph alone does not settle the diagnosis.

text.zh-CN:
目标是减少炎症和不适、保护眼睛及控制复发，各种表现分别处理。

- 丘疹脓疱常用外用抗炎药，较重时考虑口服药；持续血管和红斑可能需要不同外用药、激光或光治疗。
- 眼部受累可需要眼科、眼睑护理和专用药物；鼻部已经明显增厚时，药物未必能去除多余组织。
- 治疗常需数周到数月逐渐见效；持续护肤和诱因管理帮助维持，不能期待一次疗程永不复发。
text.en:
Goals are to reduce inflammation and discomfort, protect the eyes and control recurrence, treating each feature separately.

- Bumps and pustules often receive topical anti-inflammatory treatment, with oral medicine for more severe disease; visible vessels and lasting redness may need different topicals, laser or light treatment.
- Eye involvement may need ophthalmology, eyelid care and eye-specific medicines; medicines may not remove tissue once nasal thickening is established.
- Improvement commonly develops over weeks to months; ongoing skin care and trigger management help maintain control without guaranteeing permanent freedom from flares.

text.zh-CN:
药物按主要表现选择，不是见到“痘”就用同一种去痘产品。

- 甲硝唑、壬二酸或伊维菌素等外用药用于炎症性丘疹；选择制剂时要考虑敏感皮肤和当地批准用途。
- 多西环素有抗炎作用，并不代表玫瑰痤疮会传染；它可能引起胃肠不适、皮疹或日晒敏感，和铁锌补充剂等存在相互作用。
- 缩血管外用药可暂时减轻红色，但不处理全部炎症；激光或光治疗也有灼伤、色素改变和瘢痕风险，应由有经验的医生评估。
text.en:
Medicines are chosen for the main feature, not simply because a bump resembles acne.

- Topicals such as metronidazole, azelaic acid or ivermectin treat inflammatory bumps; formulation choice considers sensitivity and locally approved use.
- Doxycycline has anti-inflammatory effects and does not imply contagious disease; it may cause stomach upset, rash or sun sensitivity and interact with products such as iron or zinc supplements.
- Vessel-narrowing topicals may temporarily reduce redness without treating every feature; laser or light procedures can cause burns, pigment changes or scars and need experienced assessment.

text.zh-CN:
饮食建议针对诱因，不能靠统一“清热食谱”治愈。

- 热饮可先放凉再喝；若辣味反复引发潮红，试较温和版本或减少摄入，观察自身反应。
- 酒精是常见诱因，减少或不喝可帮助一些人；不能根据面红推断一个人酗酒。
- 没有发现个人关联时，不必同时排除奶制品、所有水果等整类食物；先用记录区分重复诱因与偶然碰巧。
text.en:
Dietary advice targets triggers rather than a universal curative diet.

- Let hot drinks cool; if spice repeatedly triggers flushing, try milder versions or reduce it and observe your own response.
- Alcohol is a common trigger and reduction or avoidance helps some people; facial redness does not establish alcohol misuse.
- Without a personal association, do not automatically eliminate whole groups such as dairy or all fruit; use records to distinguish repeated triggers from coincidence.

text.zh-CN:
护理要减少刺激、保持皮肤舒适，并兼顾防晒。

- 用温和洁面产品和指腹清洁，温水冲净、轻拍干；避免磨砂、用力揉搓及反复去角质。
- 使用耐受的保湿品，并用广谱SPF30或以上防晒配合遮阳；若刺痛，讨论无香精、矿物防晒等替代品。
- 运动仍可继续；如果过热会发作，可降低强度、分段活动并选择凉爽环境。眼痛或视力变化时停止自行护理并就医。
text.en:
Care aims to reduce irritation, maintain comfort and protect from sun.

- Cleanse gently with fingertips and a mild cleanser, rinse with lukewarm water and pat dry; avoid scrubs, vigorous rubbing and repeated exfoliation.
- Use a tolerated moisturizer and broad-spectrum SPF 30 or higher sunscreen with shade; if it stings, discuss fragrance-free or mineral alternatives.
- Continue activity; if overheating triggers flares, lower intensity, use shorter sessions and choose cooler surroundings. Eye pain or visual changes require medical assessment.

text.zh-CN:
肤色、年龄及妊娠会影响识别和用药选择。

- 深肤色的红斑不易看见，持续灼热、肿胀、丘疹或颜色加深同样应说明，不能仅凭“不红”排除。
- 儿童较少见，但反复红眼、麦粒肿或眼睑结痂可能是线索；需要医生区分更常见感染或过敏，不能照搬成人用药。
- 孕期或哺乳期以及儿童使用多西环素前需要专门核对；有些情况下医生权衡后可用，不能把成人长期皮肤方案直接照搬。
text.en:
Skin tone, age and pregnancy affect recognition and medicine selection.

- In darker skin, redness is harder to see; report burning, swelling, bumps or darker color rather than excluding rosacea because it is not visibly red.
- It is uncommon in children, but recurrent red eyes, styes or crusted lids may be clues; clinicians distinguish common infections or allergy and select age-appropriate treatment.
- Doxycycline needs specific review in pregnancy, breastfeeding and children; clinicians may use it in selected circumstances, but adult long-term skin regimens should not be copied automatically.

text.zh-CN:
玫瑰痤疮可有缓解期和发作期，随访关注表现和生活影响。

- 比较照片、刺痛程度、发作次数和眼症状，帮助判断当前方案；同一光线的照片比每天盯着颜色更方便比较。
- 皮肤控制后可能改用维持方案；药物减少或停用应按医生给出的具体计划，护理和防晒通常继续。
- 新眼症状、明显增厚或持续不耐受时提前复诊，这些变化可能需要调整治疗目标或专科转诊。
text.en:
Rosacea has remissions and flares; review focuses on manifestations and impact on life.

- Compare photographs, discomfort, flare frequency and eye symptoms to assess the plan; consistent lighting makes photographs easier to compare.
- Once controlled, treatment may shift to maintenance; medicine reduction or stopping follows the clinician’s plan while skin care and sun protection generally continue.
- Review earlier for new eye symptoms, increasing thickening or persistent intolerance because goals or specialist involvement may change.

text.zh-CN:
并非每个人都会发展到严重阶段，但眼睛和皮肤结构变化值得留意。

- 眼部炎症可累及角膜并影响视力；这解释了为什么眼痛、怕光或视物变化需要及时就医。
- 长期增厚可形成鼻赘，即鼻部皮肤明显肥厚，有时影响外形甚至呼吸；早期控制与已有组织重塑是不同目标。
- 外貌变化和不适可导致回避社交、焦虑或低落；心理支持与皮肤治疗可以一起进行。
text.en:
Not everyone develops severe disease, but eye and structural skin changes deserve attention.

- Eye inflammation can involve the cornea and impair vision, explaining why pain, light sensitivity or visual changes need prompt care.
- Long-standing thickening may produce rhinophyma—substantial thickening of nasal skin—sometimes affecting appearance or breathing; preventing progression and reshaping established tissue are different goals.
- Appearance changes and discomfort may lead to social avoidance, anxiety or low mood; psychological support can accompany skin treatment.

text.zh-CN:
现有措施主要减少发作和恶化，不能保证从不患病。

- 坚持适合自己的防晒、温和护理和诱因记录；一次不明原因发作不代表护理失败。
- 不要为消红长期自行用外用激素；若怀疑其他处方药诱发潮红，先联系开药医生调整，不自行停掉必要药物。
- 眼症状及皮肤增厚出现时及时处理，有助于降低进一步损害的机会。
text.en:
Current measures mainly reduce flares and worsening, without guaranteeing that rosacea never develops.

- Keep suitable sun protection, gentle care and trigger records; one unexplained flare does not mean care has failed.
- Do not self-treat redness with prolonged topical steroids; if another prescription seems to trigger flushing, contact its prescriber rather than stopping an essential medicine yourself.
- Prompt attention to eye symptoms and thickening helps reduce the chance of further harm.

limitations.zh-CN: 各节保留来源定位和地区条件；编辑证据记录中的未完成项见来源与编辑信息。
limitations.en: Section sources and regional conditions are retained; unfinished evidence checks are recorded in editorial information.
